verdict.rationale: Bento documents transactional email for receipts, password resets, login codes and account notices (bento-docs-3, bento-docs-59) as one of three email types alongside broadcasts and sequences (bento-docs-38). It markets campaigns, automations and transactional email in one place (bento-docs-75), and its CLI can send transactional emails (bento-docs-49) next to an API for marketing broadcasts (bento-docs-34). missing for 10: an explicitly cited transactional-send API endpoint with request details, explicit magic-link coverage, independent or hands-on corroboration of transactional API sending.
